newsitem.title: FINLAND: HARTWALL SAYS STILL IN TALKS WITH COKE.
newsitem.headline: HARTWALL SAYS STILL IN TALKS WITH COKE.

text.p: Finnish beverages group Hartwall Oy repeated on Tuesday it was still in talks with Coca-Cola Company about the production and distribution of Coca Cola soft drinks in Finland.
"Our negotiations with Coca-Cola are still in progress," Hartwall spokesman Tapio Hedman told Reuters.

Danish brewer Carlsberg said on Tuesday it had reached agreement with Coca-Cola on a joint venture, CCNB, for the distribution and production of soft drinks in Denmark and Sweden. Carlsberg said its intention was that the Coca Cola licensees in Finland and Norway would join CCNB as well.

"It is our plan that Norwegian and Finnish Coca-Cola licensees should participate in Coca-Cola Nordic Beverages (CCNB)," Carlsberg managing director Flemming Lindeloev told Reuters in Copenhagen earlier on Tuesday.
"We have no comment to make on Carlsberg's plans," Hedman said. Hartwall's current agreement with Coca-Cola runs until March 15, 1997.
Last week, Hartwall CEO Jussi Lansio said sales of Coca-Cola products account for about 20 percent of Hartwall's domestic sales and approximately 10 percent of domestic profit.
